observed_anchors.observation: FunctionMeta serializes parameter names but not parameter types; current compile_typed_ir admits only Int parameters while allowing Int/Bool/String returns.

OP_CALL and OP_HOSTCALL currently fail closed unless every argument is a Python int; runtime entry frames therefore rely on the narrow all-Int surface rather than serialized nominal parameter type metadata.
Canonical String literals/returns are admitted, but local/call/hostcall parameter transport remains deliberately Int-only; canonical argv is still open.

hypothesis_before_discriminator: String parameters can be safely enabled by widening only the current Int parameter gate and OP_CALL runtime guard to accept str values.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Without parameter types serialized into the admitted ClayVM artifact and checked at frame entry, merely widening value guards permits a value whose runtime type contradicts a declared Int function signature to cross the VM entry/call boundary.
